blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) conducted a blood donation drive in partnership with the Philippine Red Cross (PRC) on October 21, 2026, as part of its celebration of the National Day of Charity and the agency’s 92nd anniversary, reaffirming its commitment to public service and compassionate care for Filipinos in need. The activity was led by Dr. Clarissa Ferrer, Department Manager of the PCSO Medical Services Department, and Dr. Paulina Favie of the Philippine Red Cross. It brought together PCSO employees from various departments, along with other volunteer donors who willingly participated in the initiative to help address the blood […]...
